package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for log_printf_for_production: `log.Printf` (stdlib) usage in web service handler code
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.

func scenario416Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	log.Printf("incoming request method=%s path=%s remote=%s", r.Method, r.URL.Path, r.RemoteAddr)

	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		log.Printf("rejecting unsupported method: %s", r.Method)
		http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}

	log.Printf("request processed successfully for %s", r.URL.Path)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"ok"}`))
}
